description: Run the current editor buffer; one undo step when it is not already the stack head. Do not declare a reserved SurfCAD helper name with const, let, class, or function — the runtime passes these as function parameters: addDraft, align, array3D, booleanBodies, boundaryEdges, cboreHole, center, chamferEdges, clearanceHole, concaveEdges, convexEdges, cskHole, cut, deleteFace, draftFaces, edge, edgesBetween, edgesByOrientation, edgesOf, externalBody, faceNames, facesByNormal, facesNamed, fastenerClearanceDia, fastenerMajorDia, fastenerTapDrillDia, filletAlongPath, filletEdges, getDimensions, getScaleRatio, hexPrism, hole, holePattern, holeSpan, holesOnContour, hollow, listFastenerSizes, loft, makeCrossSection, makeExtrude, makeLoft, makeRevolve, makeSweepPath, mirror, move, moveFace, offsetPlaneFrame, patternOnPoints, placeInFrame, placeOnFace, planarFaceAt, polarArray, profileCircle, profilePolygon, profileRectangle, rectTube, resolveFastenerSize, rotateAbout, rotateContour, roundedBox, sheetMetalSolid, shell, signedFeatureEdges, solveContour, sumSqDist, surfaceOf, sweep, sweepPoints, tapDrillHole, transformByFrame, tube, vecAdd, vecCross, vecDot, vecMul, vecNorm, vecNormalize, vecSub, workplaneFromFace. A redeclaration fails; rename your variable (for example `const cut`). list_helpers { names } (over MCP) or guide { topic: "dialect" } documents each helper. If the geometry engine crashes under this part (out of memory, a wasm abort, or a run past its 30 s budget) the result is ok: false with crash { code: geometry_worker_crashed, reason: wasm_abort | out_of_memory | timeout | worker_lost, workerRestarted: true } and one failures row with the same code; status.runState is failed. The worker was already replaced and other parts kept building, so do not ask for a reload and do not retry the same script: simplify the part, lower segment counts, or split it into smaller parts, then run it again. When the run past the budget was inside one marked feature block, the part is rebuilt without that block instead: the result is ok: false with one failures row { code: feature_timeout, featureId, featureType, featureLabel, elapsedMs, budgetMs, detail }, status.runState is failed, the other features are built and shown, and status.featureMs (and feature_tree ms) say how long each block took; edit, delete, or undo that feature. Takes return: "status" | "summary" | "full" (MCP default "status": status.script is omitted; "summary" adds status.features; "full" echoes the script).

return.description: How much of status to return: "status" drops status.script, "summary" drops it and adds status.features (the feature strip), "full" keeps the whole script. Over MCP the default is "status"; in the page it is "full". Read the script with get_script.

name: run
